metadata.name: Publish - Description (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
Excited about turning data into impact? Advertising is one of the fastest moving parts of our business, and we’re seeking a sharp mind to help push it further.
Join our Ad Monetization team and turn data into revenue—owning experiments, insights, and strategies that shape the future of our ad business. As an Ad Monetization Expert, you will work across teams to optimize systems, design A/B tests, and translate data into decisions that drive growth.
Your mission is to maximize revenue by combining analytical expertise, technical understanding, and strong business acumen. If that’s a mission you want to accept, then take this opportunity to make your mark.

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Perform daily performance monitoring and analyses to support decision-making, including gathering requirements, preparing datasets, interpreting results, and communicating insights.
- Apply a proactive 'get-it-done' mindset to daily operations to maintain consistent performance and operational stability.
- Collaborate on AB testing, including planning, creating test setup, monitoring performance during the tests, and preparing post-test reports and recommendations to support evidence-based decisions.
- Design, develop, and maintain monitoring tools, dashboards, and reports to track key performance indicators and business metrics.
- Collaborate with different teams to align outcomes and process improvements with strategic business goals.
- Coordinate and support cross-functional projects, ensuring alignment between sales, tech, and analytical teams.
- Actively contribute to the development and refinement of business strategies aimed at revenue growth and improved operational performance.
- Challenge existing workflows and procedures with a continuous improvement mindset, using data to support change initiatives.
- Stay up to date with internal tools, systems, and data sources to remain effective in analysis, monitoring, and coordination efforts.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Skills (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- An analytical & technical mindset with a "hands-on" approach and good attention to detail.
- The ability to work with large datasets, interpret trends, and translate complex data into simple, actionable insights.
- Track key performance indicators, identify anomalies, and proactively support ongoing optimization initiatives
- Develop dashboards and monitor KPIs for ad performance (e.g., eCPM, ARPDAU, IMPDAU)
- A pragmatic mindset with good business sense.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment - comfortable working in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
- Positive, make-it-happen, lead-by-example attitude.
- Ability to work with different teams (Analytics team, BE, Adtech, QA). 
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Strong communication skills, with fluency in the English language (both written and spoken).

metadata.name: Publish - Required Experience (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- 3+ years of experience in roles with a strong focus on data-driven operations, business support, or performance monitoring.
- Proven experience managing ad monetization performance and working directly with ad network partners
- Experience working with cross-functional teams, acting as a bridge between technical and business departments.
- Experience with coordinating/ in managing projects across multiple departments.
- Hands-on experience with data analysis, reporting, and performance monitoring.
- Proficiency with Excel and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to support day-to-day decision-making.
- Experience conducting A/B testing of ad strategies.
- Hands-on experience with main mediation platforms (Max, Admob, Levelplay) and/or major ad networks ( Admob, AppLovin, Facebook Audience Network, Unity...).

metadata.value:
The Team
The Growth team is focused on maximising the potential of all titles Outfit7 ships. It brings together user acquisition, creative strategy, ASO, data, and product collaboration under one roof, with full-funnel accountability for the games in its portfolio. We operate across all lifecycle stages, from R&D and prototype validation through to global scale, across a range of mobile game formats.


As our Distribution Analytics Lead, you'll build and develop a high-impact team that turns complex marketing and distribution data into smarter, faster decisions. From supporting a paid user acquisition strategy to incrementality testing, you'll define how Outfit7 measures, learns, and scales across every distribution channel, and you'll grow the people who make it happen.

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Build, lead, and grow a team of analysts and data scientists supporting Marketing, Growth, and Distribution.
- Set the Distribution Analytics roadmap and priorities, focusing the team on work with the highest impact on profit growth and channel performance.
- Partner closely with Product and leadership to translate business goals into analytical initiatives, and influence strategic decisions with data.
- Own and continuously improve measurement frameworks for paid user acquisition, including LTV, ROAS, predictive payback, and bidding inputs.
- Drive the adoption of advanced measurement methods such as incrementality testing, geo experiments, and Marketing Mix Modeling.
- Champion organic growth analytics, including measurement of store performance and the interplay between paid and organic.
- Establish experimentation standards across A/B and quasi-experimental designs, statistical guardrails, and clear decision frameworks.
- Set technical standards for the team, including clean and scalable data pipelines, reproducible analyses, and well documented internal tools.
- Represent Distribution Analytics in cross-functional forums, communicate findings to senior leadership, and challenge outdated practices.
- Stay close to industry trends in mobile gaming, performance marketing, and measurement, and bring relevant best practices into the team.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Skills (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Leadership skills:  you've hired, developed, and retained talent in data analytics.
- Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect analytical work to commercial outcomes and prioritize accordingly.
- Strong SQL skills and advanced proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis, modeling and visualization.
- Deep understanding of mobile app economics, LTV and ROAS modeling, attribution, and channel performance measurement.
- Hands-on in designing and running incrementality tests, geo experiments, and/or MMM.
- Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems, run thorough analyses, and turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
- Excellent stakeholder management, you partner with non-technical leaders in Marketing and Growth 
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, fluent in English (written and spoken).
- Excellent attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset.
- A positive, proactive, lead-by-example attitude.

- Track record supporting Distribution: Paid User Acquisition, Performance Marketing, or Growth teams, ideally in mobile games or a comparable consumer app or digital business.
- Experience with modern data stack tools, such as DBT and cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake), and BI tools.
- Experience with ASO analytics and the interaction between paid and organic growth is a strong plus.

Do you want to be legal counsel for a company that works on the global scale in the fast-paced and exciting gaming industry?

We’re looking for someone to join our team and provide legal support for the company across various fields of operations. A team player would be ideal – someone who can work both collaboratively and independently – as would someone with great communication skills, a detail-oriented working style, and a passion for their work. Read on to find out more about the role! 

你是否希望加入一家全球化企业,在快速发展且充满活力的移动游戏行业担任法务顾问?

我们正在寻找一位专业、积极且富有责任心的法务顾问,为公司在多个业务领域提供法律支持。我们期待你既能够与团队紧密协作,也能够独立推动工作;具备优秀的沟通能力、严谨细致的工作态度,以及对法律工作的热情。如果你希望在国际化环境中发挥专业价值,我们期待你的加入!

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
-    Review, draft, and support the negotiation of various contracts (advertising, licensing, employment, etc.) and execute legal reviews of digital platforms to be used by the company (including legal reviews and negotiating terms and conditions, and the privacy documentation of digital platforms).
- 	Monitor, analyze, and implement PRC compliance, advertising, and other relevant regulations.
-     Provide legal support to departments company-wide, as well as legal advice to support easier decision-making and operational activities on the Chinese market. 
- 	Manage various activities in the field of personal data protection (including PIPL and other privacy regulations in place in PRC), advertising, employee data protection, and other fields.
- 	Review and prepare internal acts needed for the operation and local compliance of the company, including GPID documentation and other relevant documentation in accordance with the needs of the company.
- 	Collect and prepare data and documentation for the authorities.
- 	Coordinate and cooperate with external contractors and legal experts.
- 	Administer the process of approving and signing contracts, as well as other legal documents.
- 	Monitor compliance with regards to internal acts and external regulations.
- 	Participate in projects, provide legal assistance in various fields of the company's operations, and collaborate with other departments. 	
- 	Monitor legislation and standards, and manage any activities necessary to ensure internal compliance.
-	Manage local corporate governance and company administrative matters as per the operational needs of the company and its related companies.

 -  审核、起草并协助谈判各类合同,包括但不限于广告、授权许可、劳动用工等合同。
- 对公司拟使用的各类数字平台开展法律审查,包括平台条款(Terms & Conditions)、隐私政策及相关法律文件的审核与谈判。
- 持续关注、分析并推动中华人民共和国(PRC)关于合规、广告监管及其他相关法律法规的落地实施。
- 为公司各业务部门提供法律支持及专业法律意见,协助业务团队在中国市场高效开展运营并做出合理决策。
- 负责个人信息保护相关法律事务,包括《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》(PIPL)及其他中国隐私法律法规,同时支持广告合规、员工个人信息保护等相关工作。
- 起草、审核及更新公司内部制度、政策及运营所需法律文件,包括 GPID 相关文件及其他合规文件,确保满足公司运营及本地合规要求。
-  根据监管部门要求,收集、整理并准备相关资料及法律文件。
-  协调并管理外部律师事务所、法律顾问及其他专业服务机构的合作。
-  负责合同审批、签署流程及其他法律文件的管理工作。
-  持续监督公司内部制度及外部法律法规的执行情况,确保公司保持合规运营。
-  参与公司各类项目,为不同业务场景提供法律支持,并与各部门保持密切合作。
- 持续跟踪法律法规及行业标准变化,推动公司内部合规体系持续完善。
- 根据公司及关联公司的运营需求,负责本地公司治理(Corporate Governance)及相关公司行政法律事务。
